name: fftw3
description: FFTW is a C subroutine library for computing the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) in one or more dimensions, of arbitrary input size, and of both real and complex data (as well as of even/odd data, i.e. the discrete cosine/sine transforms or DCT/DST). tins-lib-native overlay: adds -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 so this port's own pre-3.5 CMakeLists.txt still configures under CMake 4.x.

avx.description: Builds part of the library with avx, sse2, sse

avx2.description: Builds part of the library with avx2, fma, avx, sse2, sse

neon.description: Builds part of the library with neon

sse.description: Builds part of the library with sse

sse2.description: Builds part of the library with sse2, sse
